instruction:
Sometime in November someone raised a high-priority issue for account 13 -- I can't tell you whether it was logged as a case, arrived by email, or was put on the calendar. Find out when it was opened and send a note to agent10@atlas.com, subject 'Account 13 escalation timing', with the date.

Workspace note:
- Customer touchpoints end up in different places -- some in the shared mailbox, some on the team calendar, some as CRM cases. Where a given item landed is not always known.
- Notes state dates in YYYY-MM-DD format.
expected_post_state: The item is case 67 (account 13, High, created 2025-11-15). Exactly one new outbox email to agent10@atlas.com with subject 'Account 13 escalation timing' and a body containing '2025-11-15'; no CRM changes, no events.

provenance.source_benchmark: Author-constructed (Phase 2b family P, plan uncertainty); surface style follows WorkBench (Styles et al., 2024) and the archetype-F instances
provenance.adaptation: Instance designed by the author to isolate one plan-uncertainty axis (build decision IT-055): action count derivable from a read (a), action count dependent on runtime outcomes (b), unknown source tool (c), or ordering derived from record data (d). Entities reference the deterministic seed in seed_crm.py for stable post-state predicates. Paradigm implementations are reused unchanged from archetype F.
